scope: The exterior of Panorama 1453 History Museum in September 2024, including the glass entrance pavilion and the connected circular exhibition building. The interior exhibit and lawn objects are outside the modeled scope.

originalReview.notes: The published Qualla rendition matches the Commons thumbnail in framing and detail, with small contrast and encoding differences. The sloped glass wall, sweeping timber canopy, braced framing and shaded door opening are clear.

quallaSearch.notes: The published Qualla 1920 by 1280 image matches the equivalent Wikimedia rendition visually and by pixel correlation. Yasze’s first-party photo carries an explicit own-work CC0 dedication.
